deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently removes your Three Marks profile. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.removed: Deleted: your profile, sign-in methods, favorites, goals, notifications and push subscriptions, API keys and webhooks, streamer profile and overlays, Telegram and other bot links, modpack devices and settings library, your community posts.
deleteAccount.kept: Your linked Lesta accounts are hidden from the site, and the stats, battles and replays we collected for them are erased. If you link the account again later, collection starts over.
deleteAccount.billing: An active Plus subscription stops renewing. You can get the unused days refunded on request to support — see the <terms>refund terms</terms>.
deleteAccount.dialogText: Your profile and personal data will be erased right away. You will be signed out.
deleteAccount.reauth: For your safety, sign in again and repeat the deletion right after.
deleteAccount.failed: Could not delete the account. Please try again.
